mapper.select: SELECT ut.id, ut.user_id as userId, ut.tunnel_id as tunnelId, ut.flow, ut.in_flow as inFlow, ut.out_flow as outFlow, ut.num, ut.flow_reset_time as flowResetTime, ut.exp_time as expTime, ut.speed_id as speedId, ut.status as status, ut.entry_address_mode as entryAddressMode, ut.entry_domain_id as entryDomainId, t.name as tunnelName, t.flow as tunnelFlow, t.in_ip as inIp, t.in_ip as originalEntryAddress, t.out_ip as outIp, t.type, t.protocol, CASE WHEN ut.entry_address_mode = 'CUSTOM' THEN selected_domain.domain WHEN ut.entry_address_mode = 'DEFAULT' THEN default_domain.domain ELSE NULL END as entryDomain, sl.name as speedLimitName, sl.speed FROM user_tunnel ut LEFT JOIN tunnel t ON ut.tunnel_id = t.id LEFT JOIN tunnel_entry_domain selected_domain ON selected_domain.id = ut.entry_domain_id AND selected_domain.tunnel_id = ut.tunnel_id AND selected_domain.status = 1 LEFT JOIN tunnel_entry_domain default_domain ON default_domain.tunnel_id = ut.tunnel_id AND default_domain.is_default = 1 AND default_domain.status = 1 LEFT JOIN speed_limit sl ON ut.speed_id = sl.id WHERE ut.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ut.id
